title: Robot-Led Vision Language Model Wellbeing Assessment of Children

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equalized Odds by comparing True Positive Rates (TPR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) of the model's wellbeing assessments between boys and girls, as well as testing prompt variations with and without gender information.

Calculating Spearman's correlation between the vision language model's wellbeing assessment scores and the participants' ages, and evaluating output consistency when age information is included in the prompt.
